findings.evidence: "If a branch has commits ahead of base and also uncommitted or `??` work, include both and say so. If there are no commits in scope, use working changes." These unconditional rules also apply after the specific-commit and revision-range selections, potentially introducing unrelated working changes or replacing an explicitly empty range.
findings.fix: Restrict mixed committed/uncommitted evidence and working-tree fallback to default or whole-branch reflection. Preserve explicitly requested commit and revision-range boundaries; if that scope is empty or cannot be resolved, report the limitation instead of substituting working changes.

findings.evidence: "Excessive comments | Comments that restate the code, or commented-out code left in | A comment that states a constraint or the reason for a choice is the useful kind." This is standard code-review knowledge rather than an expert-only diff interpretation check.
findings.fix: Remove the generic excessive-comments row; keep the lookup focused on non-obvious false positives and evidence checks that materially change the lesson selected.
